name: gnunet
primary_metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations (max over binary packages built from the source package)
found_by: Debian package-list review of libraries with an exported DNS decoder; metric in registry-snapshot.json round4_targeted
input_api_lead: struct GNUNET_DNSPARSER_Packet *GNUNET_DNSPARSER_parse(const char *udp_payload, size_t udp_payload_length) (gnunet_dnsparser_lib.h, libgnunetutil)
reason: Documented own decoder (header comment: 'Parse a UDP payload of a DNS packet in to a nice struct'): it decodes the header flags (Z, AD and CD included), questions, and names inside CNAME/NS/PTR/MX RDATA with compression. Not verified because it does not keep the TTL: GNUNET_DNSPARSER_parse_record stores expiration_time = now + TTL from the wall clock, and the library's own serializer recovers a TTL by truncating the remaining time, which yields TTL-1 once any time has passed. Reporting the controls' TTLs would need harness arithmetic on the clock, so it stays a lead. A/AAAA RDATA would also stay raw bytes.
